Code police oversight reports into fields

Source: R/ovr.R
ovrpar.Rd

Reads the fields of a schema from each report: the dates, the counts of officials and witnesses, the service, the outcome and whatever else the schema names, each by its rule (see ovrsch()). The rules are deterministic and offline, so the same report always gives the same row, and a folder of saved reports becomes a data set whose every value can be traced to the words that gave it.

Usage

ovrpar(x, schema = ovrsch(), html = NA)

Arguments

x

The reports: their pages (HTML) or texts, a character vector.

schema

The fields: a data frame with the character columns name, rule, cue, alt and sect, as ovrsch() gives them.

html

NA (the default) to read each element as HTML when it holds markup (a < followed by a letter, / or !), TRUE or FALSE to say.

Value

A data frame with one row per report and one column per field, in the order of schema; a row of NA for a report that is NA.

Details

Each report is first made text as ovrtxt() makes it, then each field is read by its rule; a field the report does not state is NA. A field of the rules num, tag and before is a whole number, one of the rule flag TRUE or FALSE, one of the rule date a YYYY-MM-DD date (as text), and the others text. Nothing is fetched.

Examples

r <- paste(
  "<h1>Director's Report - Case # 23-OFD-001</h1>",
  "<p>On January 6, 2023, the Barrie Police Service contacted the SIU.",
  "In the night, a 34-year-old man was injured.</p>",
  "<p>Number of SIU Investigators assigned: 3</p>",
  "<p>WO #1 Interviewed</p><p>WO #2 Interviewed</p>",
  "<p>Joseph Martino</p><p>Director</p>"
)
p <- ovrpar(r)
p[, c("case_number", "police_service", "date_siu_notified_iso",
      "siu_investigators", "number_of_witness_officials",
      "age_affected", "directors_name")]
#>   case_number        police_service date_siu_notified_iso siu_investigators
#> 1  23-OFD-001 Barrie Police Service            2023-01-06                 3
#>   number_of_witness_officials age_affected directors_name
#> 1                           2           34 Joseph Martino
